notes: These are original Joern CPG nodes/edges and original in/out solver sets; native output was not used to create the snapshots.
Flatgraph node IDs are remapped to dense local u32 IDs. ARGUMENT_INDEX is represented on ARGUMENT edge labels; FIELD_IDENTIFIER.CANONICAL_NAME is represented as Node.name.
Only edges whose endpoints belong to the method AST are retained; this suite establishes intraprocedural solver parity, not closure/global propagation parity.

Reference callee context includes methods with raw METHOD CFG edges to nodes other than METHOD_RETURN, matching Joern MethodTraversal.isNotStub. Empty real definitions and prototypes are both stubs for this rule.
Recapture using an isolated original Joern 4.0.150 process with capture.sc and target_dir=<one source file>. Do not overwrite these snapshots with native output.
